FROM district_assessments da 
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = da.district_id 
WHERE da.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
AND d.state_id IN (
    SELECT s.state_id 
    FROM states s 
    WHERE s.state_name = 'DELHI'
) 
AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM unit_assessments ua 
    JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
    WHERE ua.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
    AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
    AND u.district_id = d.district_id
) * 2 > (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM unit_assessments ua 
    JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
    WHERE ua.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
    AND u.district_id = d.district_id
)
ORDER BY da.extraction_total_ham DESC

sql:
SELECT s.state_name, COUNT(*) AS n 
FROM unit_assessments ua 
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE ua.assessment_year = '2019-2020' 
AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
GROUP BY s.state_name 
ORDER BY n DESC, s.state_name 
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    ua.category, 
    COUNT(*) AS n_units 
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua 
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
JOIN 
    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'TELANGANA' 
    AND ua.assessment_year BETWEEN '2022-2023' AND '2024-2025' 
GROUP BY 
    ua.category
ORDER BY 
    n_units DESC
